### Looking Up to the God Who Loves Me
Author: Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/looking-up-to-the-god-who-loves-me-from-his-heart-week-of-march-6.html
Passage: Psalm 8:3-4
Points:
- Gazing at the starry night sky highlights human smallness before the vastness of the cosmos.
- The majestic Creator of the universe nevertheless sets His constant thought and love upon people.
- God's affection is anchored in His own nature rather than human performance or perfection.
- Believers can rest with confidence, sharing their daily fears and worries with the One who deeply cares.

### Thinking of You
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-september-8-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 8:3-4
Points:
- While other people may rarely think about us, God keeps each of us in His thoughts constantly.
- David’s wonder under the night sky reflects the awe of God caring for frail human beings.
- The Lord knows every person individually and attends to even the smallest details of our lives.
- Believers can take comfort in knowing they are precious, valued, and never forgotten by their Father.
